messages.subject: ESEM in SAM
parts:
Hello all

I am trying to run SAM within the ESEM framework. I follow the suggestions based on this thread on Github: https://github.com/yrosseel/lavaan/issues/272

However, even using the example provided, I come across with this warning:

Warning message: lavaan->lav_model_vcov(): Could not compute standard errors! The information matrix could not be inverted. This may be a symptom that the model is not identified.

Has anyone encountered this or used SAM with ESEM before? I am using lavaan 0.6-20.2338. Thanks a lot.
